blind_protocol: Label every remaining Minus Two and Pine Valley terminal impact and contact (and near passes within 1 m) from video, telemetry and hindsight maps BEFORE any model or baseline output on the event is seen. Record blind=true, labeller and labelled_at. Oracle-route flights get oracle_route=true and are excluded from evaluation sets. The 15 curated lateral-study impacts stay in the lateral manifest and are merged by the label builder. Near passes are derived by the label builder from these points and the flown paths (geometry only, also blind).
note: Blind labels of the Minus Two and Pine Valley terminal impacts not in the lateral study manifest (F12 held-out environments). Labelled from gameplay frames and 100 Hz telemetry only, before any model or baseline output existed. point_w/normal_w/drone_pos_w are launch-relative simulator FLU (same frame as the store pos). CSV contacts in these environments coincide with terminal impacts or with the lateral-manifest non-fatal contacts, so no extra contacts are labelled here. OFFLINE evaluation data only: never a runtime input.
